title: Ludo
description: Ludo for two to four people and one phone. Nothing in Ludo is hidden, so the phone goes flat in the middle and nobody ever picks it up — take the corner nearest your colour and your name plate faces you. A real die tumbles and settles, tokens hop one square at a time, and the full rules are here: entry only on a six, an extra roll for a six or a capture or coming home, three sixes voiding the third, immunity on the eight safe squares, blockades, and an exact count to come home.
